  "review_heuristic": "Evaluate whether the diagnostic insight provides a unique theoretical or experimental approach that advances understanding, or if it is merely a descriptive observation without actionable implications or novel contributions.",
  "evidence_to_check": "Check if the paper offers a solution, mitigation strategy, or new theoretical framework based on the observed phenomenon, or if it stops at identifying the issue.",
  "failure_mode": "Overvaluing descriptive empirical findings as significant contributions when they lack novel methodology, actionable solutions, or broad generalizability beyond simple benchmarks.",
  "why_it_matters": "Significance in machine learning often requires not just identifying a problem but providing a path forward; purely diagnostic papers on simple datasets may have limited impact on the community or practical deployment.",

}
